summary: Vale S.A. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC for June 2026, which is a routine report of a foreign private issuer under Rule 13a-16 or 15d-16 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. The filing contains only administrative details, a signature by the Director of Investor Relations, and an embedded graphic. No special-situation transaction or material corporate event is described. As a standard monthly report without any acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, or other special situation content, this filing does not qualify for any special-situations category.
